detail.content:
Settings Layout: the app's frame, around the pages at /settings, /settings/billing, /settings/team/:teamId. Its controls are there whatever page is open.
Where: the app’s frame, whatever page is open.

What you can do here (tool in brackets):
On the page:
- Help [settings_help]

What the page reports: state (its fields, lists and unavailable controls) and problems.
detail.title: Settings Layout

overview.content:
Every page: sidebar groups, then their pages; a page opened from another is indented under it (from the control that opens it). After each, what it offers, by where it is (a menu, a tab), most telling first; "…": more.
Opened by address only:
- About /about: Go
- Billing /settings/billing: Go
- General Settings /settings: Go
- Project /projects/:projectId: Go
- Project Edit /projects/:projectId/edit: Go
- Projects /projects: Go
- Team /settings/team/:teamId: Go
Around /settings, /settings/billing, /settings/team/:teamId (Settings Layout): Help
Go to any page by its address with [app_navigate]. An item's page (its route has an :id) opens from the page above it.
